requested_operation: implement bounded, configurable, non-rendering active-content classification with explicit lossless, removal, quarantine, and preserve-but-mark modes

inputs.root_cause: The production package warned that notebooks can contain active MIME output but exposed no programmatic classifier or explicit handling policy. Consumers therefore had to choose between rendering unclassified content, deleting data ad hoc without a loss record, or relying on isolated prompt conventions.
inputs.affected_layer: IPYNB security boundary, public API, package security documentation

defect_reproduction.outcome: Test collection failed because format_factory.ipynb exported no SanitizationMode, SanitizationPolicy, or sanitize API.

implementation.catalog: The default active catalog covers HTML, SVG, JavaScript, and ECMAScript MIME types and is caller-configurable.
implementation.classification: Markdown/raw markup hazards, event handlers, active elements, and external resource references are identified without rendering or resolving them.
implementation.lossless: LOSSLESS is the default; it does not mutate or mark content and returns path-, hazard-, reference-, and digest-bound findings.
implementation.removal: REMOVE deletes each complete unsafe renderable payload while retaining safe alternatives in the same MIME bundle.
implementation.quarantine: QUARANTINE moves complete unsafe payloads into a non-rendered reserved metadata catalog with source paths and digests.
implementation.marking: MARK_UNTRUSTED preserves payloads and writes idempotent digest-only markers; it never copies hostile payloads into the marker catalog.
implementation.boundedness: Payload bytes, active observations, finding entries, and projected mutated output bytes are enforced through caller-supplied or safe default ResourceLimits.
implementation.preservation: Safe MIME representations and unrelated or unknown metadata remain unchanged; incompatible reserved metadata fails closed rather than being overwritten.
implementation.tradeoff: Removal and quarantine operate on complete renderable payloads. The implementation does not claim that partial regex-based rewriting can make arbitrary browser markup safe.
